name: @mathjax/src
description: Beautiful and accessible math in all browsers. MathJax is an open-source JavaScript display engine for LaTeX, MathML, and AsciiMath notation that works in all browsers and in server-side node applications. This package includes the source code as well as the packaged components.

scripts.clean:dir: clean() { node --run log:single -- "Cleaning $1 directory"; npx rimraf $1; }; clean
scripts.clean:lib: clean() { node --run log:single -- "Cleaning $1 component libs"; npx rimraf -g components/$1'/**/lib'; }; clean
scripts.clean:mod: clean() { node --run log:comp -- "Cleaning $1 module"; node --run clean:dir -- $1 && node --run clean:lib -- $1; }; clean
scripts.copy:assets: node --run log:comp -- 'Copying assets'; copy() { for name in locales mj2 mml3 html; do node --run copy:$name -- ${1:-mjs}; done; }; copy
scripts.copy:html: copy() { node --run log:single -- 'Copying sre auxiliary files'; npx copyfiles -u 1 'ts/a11y/sre/*.html' 'ts/a11y/sre/require.*' $1; }; copy
scripts.copy:locales: copy() { for name in core tex mml menu util a11y adaptors; do node --run copy:locales:$name -- ${1:-mjs}; done; }; copy
scripts.copy:locales:a11y: node --run log:single -- 'Copying a11y locales'; copy() { npx copyfiles -u 1 'ts/a11y/*/__locales__/*.json' $1; }; copy
scripts.copy:locales:adaptors: node --run log:single -- 'Copying DOMAdaptor locales'; copy() { npx copyfiles -u 1 'ts/adaptors/*/__locales__/*.json' $1; }; copy
scripts.copy:locales:core: node --run log:single -- 'Copying core locales'; copy() { npx copyfiles -u 1 'ts/core/__locales__/*.json' $1; }; copy
scripts.copy:locales:menu: node --run log:single -- 'Copying menu locales'; copy() { npx copyfiles -u 1 'ts/ui/menu/__locales__/*.json' $1; }; copy
scripts.copy:locales:mml: node --run log:single -- 'Copying MathML locales'; copy() { npx copyfiles -u 1 'ts/input/mathml/__locales__/*.json' $1; }; copy
scripts.copy:locales:util: node --run log:single -- 'Copying utility locales'; copy() { npx copyfiles -u 1 'ts/util/*/__locales__/*.json' $1; }; copy
scripts.copy:locales:tex: node --run log:single -- 'Copying TeX locales'; copy() { npx copyfiles -u 1 'ts/input/tex/__locales__/*.json' $1 && npx copyfiles -u 3 'ts/input/tex/*/__locales__/*.json' $1/input/tex; }; copy
scripts.copy:mj2: copy() { node --run log:single -- 'Copying legacy code AsciiMath'; npx copyfiles -u 1 'ts/input/asciimath/legacy/**/*' $1; }; copy
scripts.copy:mml3: copy() { node --run log:single -- 'Copying MathML3 extension json'; npx copyfiles -u 1 ts/input/mathml/mml3/mml3.sef.json $1; }; copy
scripts.copy:pkg: copy() { node --run log:single -- "Copying package.json to $1"; npx copyfiles -u 2 components/bin/package.json $1; }; copy
scripts.cjs:build: node --run log:header -- 'Building cjs'; node --run cjs:src:build && node --run cjs:components:build
scripts.cjs:compile: node --run cjs:copy:components && node --run cjs:copy:ts && node --run cjs:compile:tsc
scripts.cjs:compile:tsc: node --run log:single -- 'Compiling cjs typescript files' && npx tsc --project tsconfig/worker-cjs.json && npx tsc --project tsconfig/cjs.json
scripts.cjs:components:build: node --run log:comp -- 'Building cjs components'; node --run cjs:components:src:build && node --run clean:dir -- bundle-cjs && node --run cjs:components:make -- --build
scripts.cjs:components:clean: node --run log:single -- "Cleaning cjs components"; npx rimraf components/cjs
scripts.cjs:components:compile: node --run log:single -- 'Compiling component files'; npx tsc --project tsconfig/components.json
scripts.cjs:components:finalize: node --run log:comp -- 'Finalize cjs components'; node --run cjs:components:copy && node --run copy:pkg -- components/cjs && node --run clean:lib -- cjs
scripts.cjs:components:make: make() { node --run log:single -- 'Making cjs components'; node components/bin/makeAll --cjs --terse --bundle-cjs $1 $2 $3 components/cjs; }; make
scripts.cjs:components:src:build: node --run log:comp -- 'Building cjs components sources'; node --run cjs:components:clean && node --run cjs:components:compile && node --run cjs:components:finalize
scripts.cjs:src:build: node --run log:comp -- 'Building cjs sources'; node --run link:src && node --run clean:dir -- cjs && node --run cjs:compile && node --run copy:assets -- cjs && node --run copy:pkg -- cjs
scripts.cjs:copy:components: node --run log:single -- 'Moving cjs files from components' && npx copyfiles -u 2 'components/mjs/**/*.cjs' 'components/mjs/**/*.d.cts' components/cjs
scripts.cjs:copy:ts: node --run log:single -- 'Moving cjs files from ts' && npx copyfiles -u 1 'ts/**/*.cjs' cjs
scripts.mjs:build: node --run log:header -- 'Building mjs'; node --run mjs:src:build && node --run mjs:components:build
scripts.mjs:compile: node --run log:single -- 'Compiling mjs typescript files'; npx tsc --project tsconfig/mjs.json && npx tsc --project tsconfig/worker.json
scripts.mjs:components:build: build() { node --run log:comp -- 'Compiling mjs component files'; node --run clean:lib -- mjs && node --run clean:dir -- bundle && node --run mjs:components:make -- $1 && node --run mjs:bundle:finalize; }; build
scripts.mjs:components:make: make() { node --run log:single -- 'Making mjs components'; node components/bin/makeAll --mjs --terse --locale ${1:-en} components/mjs; }; make
scripts.mjs:src:build: node --run log:comp -- 'Building mjs sources'; node --run link:src && node --run clean:dir -- mjs && node --run mjs:compile && node --run copy:assets -- mjs
scripts.mml3-xslt: node --run mml3:pre:xslt && node --run mml3:make:xslt && node --run mml3:post:xslt
scripts.lab:sre: node --run log:single -- 'Making lab/sre'; node components/bin/makeAll --terse lab/build
scripts.link:src: node --run log:single -- 'Setting symbolic link'; node components/bin/link-full
scripts.clean: node --run clean:mod -- cjs && node --run cjs:bundle:clean && node --run clean:mod -- mjs && node --run clean:dir -- bundle
scripts.make-cjs-components: make() { node --run cjs:components:make -- $1 $2 && node --run cjs:bundle:finalize; }; make
scripts.build-all: build() { node --run build-mjs -- $1; echo ; node --run build-cjs -- $1; }; build
